question: On the Companion now installed (16, 0.2.0), does a running frame trace starve the REGION copier, as it did on 15?
handset: moto g56 5G, Android 16; the local profile's serial
conditions: FNaF 2 title menu (animated), capture started by cue_setup (named controls only, no game input), under the serial lease; static-view-moto-g56-v207.json set `static`; native-regions.ts record for 8 s, then a frame trace started and the same record for 8 s, then the trace stopped (it reported 511 frames).
reading: Companion 16 copies the static_view region on every frame, 60.1 fps, with or without a running frame trace (481 of 481 rows each way, no gap over 20.3 ms). On Companion 15 the same record kept 288 frames in 10 s without the trace and 0 under it (2026-10-01, the night of night7-k3-sr03). night-run.sh no longer refuses --static-readout beside --frame-trace.

companion15.underTrace: 0 frames while the trace took 553 in 8 s
